name: Es Kopi Susu Gula Aren
Iced Palm Sugar Milk Coffee
description: Espresso double ristretto dengan susu segar dingin dan sirup gula aren organik Garut.
Double ristretto espresso with cold fresh milk and organic Garut palm sugar syrup.

V60-brewed Garut Kamojang Arabica with notes of tropical fruit, black tea and sweet chocolate.
